sidebar.sem_avatar: no avatar yet — set one in the profile module.
aparencia.idioma.desc: the language of every screen. what you wrote (notes, goal names…) stays as it is.
aparencia.idioma.aviso_ia: translated with the help of AI — spotted something odd? corrections are welcome.
erro.confirmacao_invalida: invalid confirmation; send confirmation='{palavra}' to continue
erro.backups.copia_inexistente: that copy isn't in the backups folder
erro.erro_interno: something went wrong in Kami while doing this
erro.banco_ocupado: the database is busy with another process — try again in a moment
erro.sem_espaco: no disk space left to save — free up some space and try again
erro.banco_inacessivel: couldn't read or write the database — check that Kami's data folder is reachable (disconnected drive, permissions or antivirus)
erro.banco_corrompido: the database looks corrupted — restore a backup in settings › backup and data
